name: research-solution-supervisor
title_zh: 盯着你的研究方案有没有真往前走一步
tagline_zh: AI 说「已完成」时，它逐条比对研究计划：哪一步真做了、哪一步只是换了措辞复述、下一步该补哪个缺口。
tagline_en: When the AI says "done", it checks the plan step by step: what was really done, what was just rephrased, what gap.
desc_en: Supervise whether an AI response, research pass, or proposed solution has adequately advanced the user's research plan. Use when the user asks to 监督/检查/评估 AI 是否真正解决了方案, keep a research workflow moving, audit progress against a plan, or decide the next effective research step. Do not use for ordinary code review, final document polishing, or pure requirement clarification with no research/solution
why_zh: 它不评文笔也不挑代码风格，只问一句：相对你的研究计划，这一步推进了什么。答不上来就算没做。
why_en: It ignores prose and code style, asking only: relative to your research plan, what did this advance? No answer means not done.
limit_zh: 前提是你得先有一份写下来的研究计划，口头目标它无从比对；它只判「有没有推进」，不替你补做研究、不改代码、不润色文档。
limit_en: Requires a written research plan — verbal goals can't be compared. It only judges whether progress happened: it won't do the research, fix code, or.
title_en: Audits whether your research plan actually moved forward
